backend.title: Ba a Iya Samun Sabar
backend.description: Ba a iya samun sabar asali na ɗan lokaci, don haka ba za ta iya sarrafa wannan buƙata ba. Muna ba da haƙuri kan duk wata matsala.

clienttimeout.title: Lokacin Jiran Buƙata Ya Ƙare
clienttimeout.description: Yi haƙuri, lokacin jira ya ƙare yayin loda wannan shafin yanar gizo. Muna ba da haƙuri kan duk wata matsala da hakan ya iya jawo.

forbidden.title: An Hana Shiga
forbidden.description: Ba ka da izinin shiga wannan shafin. Idan wannan kuskure ne, da fatan ka tuntuɓi mai kula da gidan yanar gizon.

upstream.title: Ba a Iya Samun Sabar
upstream.description: A yanzu babu wata saba da ke kan layi kuma a shirye take don sarrafa wannan buƙata. Muna ba da haƙuri kan duk wata matsala.

invalid_configuration.title: Saituna Marasa Inganci
invalid_configuration.description: Ba za mu iya sarrafa wannan buƙata ba saboda kuskuren saituna. Muna ba da haƙuri kan duk wata matsala.

resource.description_start: Abin takaici, an sami kuskure yayin loda wannan shafin.

ssl-https-http.title: Buƙata Marar Inganci
ssl-https-http.description: Ana iya shiga wannan gidan yanar gizon ta HTTPS. Ka yi ƙoƙarin haɗawa ta HTTP, yanzu za mu gwada tura ka zuwa hanyar da ta dace. Idan ba a tura ka ba, da fatan ka ƙara https:// a farkon URL ɗinka sannan ka sake gwadawa.

timeout.title: Ba a Iya Samun Sabar
timeout.description: Yi haƙuri, lokacin jira ya ƙare yayin loda wannan shafin. Mai yiwuwa sabar tana da aiki sosai kuma ba za ta iya sarrafa buƙatarka a yanzu ba.

unknown_domain.title: Sunan Yanki da Ba a Sani Ba
unknown_domain.description: Ba a yi wa wannan sunan yanki rajista da wannan adireshin IP ba.

unsupported_method.title: Hanyar da Ba a Tallafawa
unsupported_method.description: Ba a kunna hanyar HTTP da aka nema ga wannan gidan yanar gizon ba.

ssl-insecure.title: Buƙata Marar Tsaro
ssl-insecure.description: Ba a kunna ƙa'idar HTTPS da aka nema ga wannan gidan yanar gizon ba. Da fatan ka sabunta burauzarka.

maintenance.title: An Kashe don Kulawa
maintenance.description: Ba a iya samun wannan gidan yanar gizon a yanzu. Ana sa ran za a sake samun sa nan ba da daɗewa ba.
